items.summary: CTO approval: create no new proposals, production requests, experiments, telemetry requests, dependencies, spend, or external outreach this cycle. Continue only existing reconciliation, failed-run containment, measurement, bounded security evidence, and private launch-readiness work. Requeue is blocked until deduplication, ownership, root cause, isolated validation, rollback, and queue eligibility are documented. Preserve unavailable revenue, attribution, ROI, margin, causal lift, cost-to-learn, and operational health as unknown.

CTO review: the proposed containment-only plan is technically feasible, isolated, reversible, and safe to remain in the existing queue as work-item updates. Use only already-available source-dated impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, site-attributed commission, and AI cost. Do not request duplicate telemetry or treat missing fields as zero.

Keep the gated product private. Continue internal rights, data-flow, consent, vendor, retention, accuracy, security, and measurement evidence preparation only. The permission-request draft remains unsent pending owner authorization and human counsel review.
